editorial:
Imagine spending your whole life waiting for your turn to run the family business, only to find out the guy who built it all was a complete stranger. That is exactly where you find Sérgio in this tense drama. He is hungry for power and wants to take over the construction company so he can finally chase his own old dreams. The vibe is heavy and full of secrets, making you feel the pressure of family expectations. You will see Sérgio push everyone away to get what he wants, but the movie turns into a mystery when he digs up some dark secrets about his dad's past that change everything.

The acting is top-notch and makes the family fights feel real and messy. While the middle part slows down a bit, the big reveals keep you glued to your seat. If you love stories about family lies and power struggles, you need to see this.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you discover that the father actually built the company using stolen money and illegal deals. This twist proves that Sérgio is just like his father, using people to get ahead. Instead of taking over the business, Sérgio decides to walk away from the money to clear his conscience. He chooses his own peace over the family legacy, finally breaking the cycle of lies and greed.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family dramas with a dark twist.
